authors.name: Kun Xu
authors.institution: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
authors.bio: Kun Xu studies the security and reliability of generative AI, with a focus on concept-level risks in text-to-image models and deepfake detection. His work also examines uncertainty, calibration, and privacy-aware synthesis, connecting model evaluation with trustworthy deployment.

authors.name: Yushu Zhang
authors.institution: Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics
authors.bio: Yushu Zhang researches multimedia security, privacy protection, and trustworthy artificial intelligence. His work spans image privacy across data, content, and feature representations, alongside cybersecurity and blockchain. He supervises doctoral research and is an IEEE Senior Member.

authors.name: Xiangli Xiao
authors.institution: Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics
authors.bio: Xiangli Xiao researches financial information security and multimedia content security, including watermarking and digital copyright protection. He earned his Ph.D. in cybersecurity at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics and teaches applied cryptography and privacy-preserving computing.

authors.name: Shuren Qi
authors.bio: Shuren Qi studies principled and scalable data representations at City University of Hong Kong. His research examines invariance, symmetry, and hierarchy as inductive biases, developing learning frameworks that combine theoretical foundations with transparent structure and scalability.

sources.note: Homepage explicitly states current CityU postdoctoral appointment and both email addresses. Portrait is the img with alt=Shuren Qi and src=files/shuren_2025.jpg.

authors.name: Tao Wang
authors.institution: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
authors.bio: Tao Wang is a doctoral student at Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics, supervised by Yushu Zhang. He studies AI privacy, contextual privacy, and privacy evaluation, and previously visited the University of Milan to work with Pierangela Samarati.

authors.name: Barbara Carminati
authors.bio: Barbara Carminati studies security and privacy in data management and data-intensive applications at the University of Insubria. Her work spans access control, decentralized systems, IoT, and security analytics. She is an ACM Distinguished Member and an IEEE Senior Member.

authors.name: Elena Ferrari
authors.bio: Elena Ferrari leads the STRICT SociaLab at the University of Insubria. Her research develops secure and privacy-preserving data-sharing technologies across social networks, IoT, and data systems. She is an ACM Fellow and an IEEE Fellow.

authors.name: Yuming Fang
authors.institution: Jiangxi University of Finance and Economics
